title: Atlas instance 1.1
description: One instance of the atlas codebase (instances/<id>/instance.json): the brand, the default catalog and lens, the lenses, tools and pages it builds, its release registry and seal when it has them, and its size budget. VITE_INSTANCE=<id> selects it at build time. Every key here is read by the code (src/lib/brand/instance.ts, scripts/instance.mjs, scripts/size-budget.mjs); nothing else is allowed. 1.1 (build week 4, step 1) adds lenses, pages, release, seal and budget and widens tools to report; lenses, tools, pages, release and seal choose the modules the build includes (scripts/instance-modules.mjs); repo, download, release.docs and report (build week 4 step 2) carry the strings the moved MarineSensitivity modules used to hard-code.

allOf.description: defaults.lens is one of lenses (one rule per lens; tests/instances.test.ts checks every lens has its rule)
an instance that publishes the report page names its report strings

lens.description: a lens any instance builds: the union the Lens type becomes in build week 4 step 2 (collection and species here, scores from MarineSensitivity/atlas)

tool.description: a rail tool any instance builds: the union the ToolName type becomes in build week 4 step 2 (report from MarineSensitivity/atlas)

page.description: an HTML entry an instance may publish (<page>.html at the repo root); the gallery stays dev-only and is never one

assetFile.description: a file under instances/<id>/assets/, served next to the page

relativeUrl.description: a page-relative URL of a file under instances/<id>/assets/ ("./logos/x.png")

name.description: the brand name in prose ("OceanMetrics Atlas")

wordmark.description: the topbar/About/catalog wordmark: three parts [ink, accent, light] rendered as the first two run together, a space, then the third ("OceanMetrics Atlas"), or one string rendered as is

title.description: the HTML <title> of the map page before the app sets its own

description.description: the meta and og:description of the map page

siteUrl.description: where the build is published (og:url); og:image is resolved against it

image.description: the 1200x630 PNG card under assets/ (rendered from its .svg by scripts/render-og.mjs); without it no og:image tags are written

mark.description: the mark, an SVG file in the instance folder inlined by src/lib/brand/Mark.svelte (colours from currentColor and custom properties only)

credit.description: the line the map attribution chip and the catalog footer carry

cite.description: how to cite the atlas itself

credits.description: an optional "prepared by" line under the About dialog's links

base.description: the default catalog base (src/lib/catalog/base.ts); ?catalog= and VITE_CATALOG_BASE override it

groups.description: the picker groups in display order, each a CatalogGroup id (src/lib/catalog/load.ts) and its label

lenses.description: the lenses this instance builds, in the order the lens switch shows them; defaults.lens is one of them

lens.description: the lens the app opens on, one of lenses (the allOf rule); a lens this build's Lens union lacks falls back to collection (src/lib/state/types.ts)

tools.description: the rail, in order; the rail keeps the members of this build's ToolName union (src/shell/tools.ts) and drops the rest (report until build week 4 step 2)

pages.description: the HTML entries this instance publishes; always index (the map)

repo.description: the GitHub repository (owner/name) the feedback issues are filed in and the Docs and changelog links point at

prefix.description: the first part of every downloaded figure's file name ({prefix}_{lens}_{layer}_..., src/lib/download/filename.ts)

app.description: the key the shared feedback Apps Script knows this app by

attribution.description: the credit of the built-in places collection

host.description: the titiler origin, no trailing slash

release.description: the release registry this instance reads (latest.txt, versions.json, {ver}/manifest.json), present only for an instance that has one

registry.description: the registry base, with a trailing slash

preview.description: the preview origin restricted versions open on ({preview}/{ver}/atlas/), no trailing slash

access.description: gate: a restricted version opens only through the preview host's access check (fail closed)

docs.description: the release documentation book's root, with a trailing slash ({docs}{ver}/apps/atlas.html; a restricted release's book is on the preview origin)

seal.description: the agency seal (About, report cover, footer), present only for an instance that may show it

agency.description: the agency code the seal belongs to; an unknown code shows no seal (fail closed)

src.description: the seal image, an https URL or a file under assets/

report.description: the report page's strings, present when pages names report

stem.description: the first part of an export's file stem ({stem}_{slug}_{ver}_{date})

nav.description: the Ocean Metrics bar (@oceanmetrics/nav, one navigation bar for the apps and the site) above the top bar, or false for an instance without it; `current` is the id of the item to mark (places, indicators, atlas, or an id of `items`)

items.description: replaces the bar's five default items; doors sit left of the search, links right of it

mark.description: the instance's own mark in the bar, a file under assets/

label.description: the wordmark text and accessible names

budget.description: the gzip size budgets scripts/size-budget.mjs holds this instance's build to, in KB

static_kb.description: the static path of index.html (everything loaded before the first interaction)

worker_kb.description: the runtime workers referenced from the static path
